Applies to:
Microsoft Defender Experts for XDR
Microsoft Defender Experts for Servers
For managed detection and response instructions, check out this short video.
Through a combination of automation and human expertise, Microsoft Defender Experts for
XDR triages Microsoft Defender XDR incidents, prioritizes them on your behalf, filters out the
noise, carries out detailed investigations, and provides actionable managed response to your
security operations center (SOC) teams.
Once our experts start investigating an incident, the incident's Assigned to and Status fields
are updated to Defender Experts and In progress, respectively.
When our experts conclude their investigation on an incident, the incident's Classification field
is updated to one of the following, depending on the experts' findings:
True Positive
False Positive
Informational, Expected Activity
The Determination field corresponding to each classification is also updated to provide more
insights on the findings that led our experts to determine the said classification.
